name: 50125 · Indianola, IA
findings: ZIP 50125 (Indianola) has 105 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 50125 (Indianola) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
